description: Screen and rank ALL companies by one fiscal year's reported financials — the cross-company comparison tool. Filter by min/max bounds on revenue, net income, operating income, gross profit, operating cash flow, capital expenditures, total assets, total liabilities, stockholders' equity, cash, long-term and short-term debt, plus two kinds of derived metrics (always flagged derived:true): total_debt (long-term + short-term debt at the same balance-sheet date, present only when both were reported) and the margins net_margin / operating_margin / gross_margin (computed from the year's reported values, expressed as decimals — 0.10 means 10%). Optionally restrict by SIC industry (sic exact code or sic_prefix industry group). Results sort by any of those metrics (sort_by, default revenue; sort_dir desc/asc) and paginate with limit (default 50, max 200) and offset. Use for questions like 'largest profitable companies in FY2024' or 'companies with revenue over $10B and net margin above 15%'; use get_financials for one company's full statements and get_metric_history for one company's trend. Read-only; no API key. fiscal_year defaults to the latest year with broad coverage (>= 1000 companies reporting revenue in the unit). Money metrics compare within ONE presentation currency (unit, default USD) — no FX conversion is attempted, matching the rankings endpoint. Data honesty: a company lacking a filtered metric is EXCLUDED, never treated as zero; the response reports `screened` (companies with any stored metric for that year and unit) vs `matched` (passing every filter and reporting the sort metric). Each returned metric carries its value, unit, derived flag, and source-filing provenance (filed date, form, accession number). Screening is per filer (CIK); predecessor-chain history is not merged here.

fiscal_year.description: Fiscal year to screen (1990-2030). Default: latest year with broad coverage

sic_prefix.description: SIC prefix (industry group), e.g. '35'. Pass sic or sic_prefix, not both

sort_by.description: Metric to rank by. Default: revenue

unit.description: Presentation currency for money metrics (default USD). No conversion is performed

name: screen_companies
